# jspassgen - Full Cryptographic & Engineering Context

## Overview
jspassgen is an open-source security tool and cryptographic library providing secure password and passphrase generation across Web, Node.js, and Terminal CLI environments.

## Cryptographic Security Properties
1. Entropy Sourcing: Uses standard CSPRNGs (Web Crypto API `crypto.getRandomValues` in browsers; `crypto.randomBytes` in Node.js).
2. Elimination of Modulo Bias: Rejection sampling is strictly enforced across all integer selection algorithms to guarantee uniform distribution across character sets.
3. EFF Diceware Dictionary: Full 7,776-word dictionary compiled by the Electronic Frontier Foundation, offering log2(7776) = 12.9155 bits of entropy per word.
4. Active Honeywords: Implements the Juels-Rivest honeywords system. Authentic-looking decoys are placed into credential stores to detect unauthorized database compromises.
5. Post-Quantum Readiness: Employs memory-hard KDF derivation (Argon2id) resistant to Grover's algorithm and high-throughput ASIC/GPU brute-force search.
6. Zero Telemetry & Offline Execution: No credentials or analytics packets leave the local device boundary.
